name: easygee
description: Google Earth Engine, geemap, GeoMaster, and GEE Growth Diary workflows with catalog search, auth guidance, quota checks, and a lightweight local map console.

interface.shortDescription: Use GEE, geemap, quotas, catalog search, and browser maps from Codex.
interface.longDescription: EasyGEE packages a Google Earth Engine and geemap workflow layer for agents, plus bundled GeoMaster and GEE Growth Diary skill snapshots for local GIS, CRS, remote sensing, ML, STAC/COG, scientific-domain methods, and distilled Chinese GEE cookbook patterns. It provides credential-safe authentication guidance, Cloud project and quota checks, Earth Engine catalog search, method routing, reusable GEE/geemap scripts, and a lightweight browser map console for AOI drawing, layer inspection, and visualization handoff.
